messages.subject: Re: FIELDimageR: Re: Problem with Blue=NULL in fieldMask() for Parrot Sequoia+
messages.subject_clean: FIELDimageR: Re: Problem with Blue=NULL in fieldMask() for Parrot Sequoia+
messages.body_plain:
Hi Alexandre,

I am sorry about my delay. I have been very busy this last month.

I believe the default position for FIELDimageR output images (or layers names) is always "Red", "Green", "Blue", "RedEdge", and "NIR".

In your case, you do not need to change layers' names as showing on your code. You need only exclude the layer "Blue" and continue working with the other layers. Is that make sense?

We will work on a way to allow using NULL on the RGB layers. I will let you know...!!!

Let me know if you have any other questions.
All the best,
Filipe

messages.body_plain:
Olá Rafael,

Me parece que você está tentando abrir/usar mais núcleos do que e permitido para o computador.

Você está usando a função fieldInfo dentro de um parallel?

O que acontece quando o n.core=NULL?

Você tentou desinstalar o FIELDimageR e instalar novamente?

Quando coloquei o erro no Google essa página veio como sugestao: https://github.com/HenrikBengtsson/Wishlist-for-R/issues/28

Me avise se conseguiu resolver.

Tudo de bom,

Filipe

messages.body_plain:
I'm trying to run FieldimageR using a shapefile I generated in ArcMap. I'm not so sure about how to specify the plot id. In my case, the plot id is called point_num.Do I need to create a fieldshape object first?

shapefile <- readOGR("shapefiles/transect_2m.shp")

# Uploading multispectral mosaic:
EX1.5b <- stack("multispec_ortho.tif")

EX1.5b.Indices <- fieldIndex(EX1.5b,Red=1,Green=2,Blue=3,RedEdge=4,NIR=5,
                             index = c("NDVI","NDRE"))

EX1.5b.Info <http://EX1.5b.Info><- fieldInfo(mosaic = EX1.5b.Indices$NDVI,fieldShape = shapefile ,n.core = 3)

messages.subject: Re: Workflow for using shapefile from other software
messages.subject_clean: Workflow for using shapefile from other software
messages.body_plain:
Hi Daniel,

The function fieldShape() and fieldPolygon() builds the shapefile and connects a data.frame (data from the field) or plots ID automaticly. For more informations check this link: https://github.com/OpenDroneMap/FIELDimageR#P5.

Right now, those functions do not insert IDs on prebuild shapefiles. Actually, this is one up great on our list of things to do.

One suggestion is to try to draw a shapefile above the one that you already have. The idea is to plot the one that you already have and use it as a base to draw the new one. Is that make sense?

Please, let me know if this helps you. Otherwise, you can share your files here and I can help you with that. There is a coding way to do it, but I need an example to make it. Please provide the shapefile and the map (matrix with the IDs position).

All the best,
Filipe
